import io
from unittest.mock import patch
from dotenv.main import dotenv_values
from dotenv.variables import Variable, parse_variables

# 1) 直接 None 展开为空字符串
assert Variable("X", "fallback").resolve({"X": None}) == ""
# 2) 普通值保留内容
assert Variable("X", "fallback").resolve({"X": "present"}) == "present"
# 3) 缺失变量使用默认值
assert Variable("X", "fallback").resolve({}) == "fallback"
# 4) 无默认值且缺失时为空
assert Variable("X", None).resolve({}) == ""
# 5) 通过 dotenv 插值: A 为空值(None), B=${A} 应为 ""
with patch.dict(__import__("os").environ, {}, clear=True):
    vals = dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO("A=\nB=${A}\nC=plain\nD=${C}\n"))
print(vals)
assert vals["A"] is None
assert vals["B"] == ""
assert vals["C"] == "plain"
assert vals["D"] == "plain"
# 6) 混合字面量
env = {"X": None, "Y": "second"}
out = "".join(a.resolve(env) for a in parse_variables("pre-${X}-mid-${Y}-post"))
print(repr(out))
assert out == "pre--mid-second-post"
print("INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION PASSED")
EOF
